paragraphs: Mentioned in Pesikta Rabbati, Parah, at the source’s folio locator דפ״ז, reporting in the name of R' Shmuel bar Nachman.[^1][^2]

notes.text: דשאב is read as of Sha’av, with conventional vowels; earlier audit רשאב and provisional heading status remain unresolved.

פס׳ רבתי פ׳ פרה is read contextually as Pesikta Rabbati, Parah. דפ״ז is retained literally; 87 is a possible folio reading, without verified pagination, side or modern edition mapping. No named witness is independently checked. Both personal title abbreviations remain R'.
